english.title: Falsely represent self to be authorised in official capacity to claim / enforce payment - Admin. of Justice Act 1970
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with the object of coercing another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to pay money claimed from

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

as a debt due under a contract, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEBT AND CONTRACT..), falsely represented yourself to be authorised in some official capacity to claim or enforce payment
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40(1)(c) and(4) of the Administration of Justice Act 1970.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
